thread: **Issue #1831 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #1831: Patch: friends in the top-right corner of every screen, and challenging a friend in fewer steps Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does Today a player's friends live on one page, `/together` (`apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.tsx`), reached from the `/play` hub. To challenge a friend you leave the screen you're on, open Play together, press Challenge, pick a mode and a deck in `ChallengeDialog.tsx`, and send. The friend then presses Accept on the toast (`ChallengeToast.tsx`), lands on `/play` with the code filled in (R767), picks a deck and presses Join. That's too many steps, and friends are out of sight on every other screen. This patch puts friends in the **top-right corner of every screen**, always there for a signed-in active account, and cuts the steps on both sides of a challenge. SPEC §9.5 ("Play together", "Challenging a friend") and R767 describe the current flow, so the spec text changes with the code (CLAUDE.md rule 1, rule 3). **1. A Friends button in the top-right cluster, on every screen** - A new `together/FriendsButton.tsx` sits in the top-right control group, to the left of the language button and the settings gear, everywhere those two appear: `routes/nav.tsx`'s `BackLink` (every inner screen), the landing (`routes/landing.tsx`), the match board's bar (`game/Board.tsx`, `placement="game"`), the practice and lesson HUDs, the Duos board, the replay player and `/watch`. Match `SettingsButton`'s `placement` prop and its popover pattern. - Show it only while the tab holds a session for an active account (the same `signedIn` read `main.tsx` uses for `ChallengeToast`). Hide it on signed-out screens (sign-in, password reset), as the Jlore pill is. - A badge on the button counts what needs the player: incoming friend requests plus incoming challenges plus unread chats. Take these numbers from the reads the shell already makes every `SOCIAL_POLL_MS` (the challenge toast's `GET /api/challenges` and the unread counts). Share one poll and add no new one, so server load stays as it is. - On the match board, this button replaces `InMatchChat.tsx`'s separate rail toggle, so there is one friends entry, not two. Chat keeps working from inside the panel. **2. The friends panel** - Pressing the button opens a panel: a popover on desktop, a full-width sheet at phone width. It holds: - the player's own `name#tag` with a Copy button; - the add form by `name#tag`, showing the server's refusal in its own words; - incoming requests (Accept and Decline); - the friends list, online first, each row with its status dot and Challenge, Watch and Chat exactly as `TogetherRoute.tsx`'s `FriendRow` decides them today (the server's status, CLAUDE.md rule 7; no client-side legality); - a link to "All of Play together" (`/together`). - Read the friends list (`FRIENDS_POLL_MS`) only while the panel is open, as `InMatchChat.tsx` already does for its list. SPEC §9.5's Presence bullet keeps its pace rule. Generalise its "the match board only while its chat list is open" to "any screen only while its friends panel is open". - `/together` stays as the full page: blocked players, "Shared with me", outgoing requests and the co-op panel. Do not remove or redirect the route (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Challenging takes one confirm** - `ChallengeDialog.tsx` opens with the player's last challenge mode and deck (or trio) already chosen and Send focused, so a repeat challenge is Challenge then Enter. Remember the last pick per browser in the settings store (a per-viewer convenience). With nothing remembered, or a remembered deck that is no longer saved, fall back to the first saved deck in the current default mode. The server still decides whether the deck may be played (rule 7). - The dialog opens from the friends panel without leaving the current screen. Sending a challenge from inside a match is not offered (the button is disabled there, with the server's reason in its title) because the server refuses it anyway (SPEC §9.5). **4. Accepting takes one press** - The incoming-challenge toast shows the challenge's mode and a deck picker with the player's last deck for that mode already chosen. **Accept joins the room straight from the toast** (`POST` to the room's join with that deck) and goes to the game. An All Random challenge needs no deck, so Accept just joins. If the join is refused (a deck the server rejects, the challenge gone), show the refusal in the toast and offer "Open in lobby", the current R767 path with the code filled in. - This changes §9.5's "accepting it is joining the room by its code, the lobby opened with the code filled in". Rewrite that sentence: accepting is still joining the room by its code (which still marks the challenge accepted), now done from the toast with the chosen deck, the lobby being the fallback. Add a ruling note in this issue's block (R<this issue>000, `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers) that records the change and cites R767. R767 itself still governs room *links*. - R1754000 still holds: a screen with unsaved work (the card creator) asks before the toast's Accept leaves it. Touches only `apps/web` (plus `spec/09-*.md`, the new ruling note, `spec/INDEX.md` through `cargo jackioh spec index`, `apps/web/README.md`'s "Play together and Duos" section, and `e2e/support/testids.ts` for the new test ids).
